acceptanceCriteria: The launch-lock wait is bounded by the same command deadline as the running-lock wait and the await.
A test with two concurrent --detach launchers of one record shows --wait 0 returns within a small bound with a named outcome.
body: Residual from V1-1671 review fix (PR #1095, head 143979ca2). leaseDetachLaunch calls lockLeaseDetach(leaseDetachLockName, leaseDetachLockBound) before the single command deadline applies, so a concurrent --detach of the same record can block up to 10 s even with --wait 0. A launcher that now waits on the running lock (up to min(10 s, its --wait)) lengthens that hold. Expected: --wait 0 returns immediately even under launcher contention; --wait N returns within N plus scheduling slack. Recorded as a failure mode in the amended ATR-V0-095 text.
title: tasks lease --detach: launch-lock wait (up to 10 s) runs outside the caller --wait bound under concurrent launchers (ATR-V0-024)
